en: A black-and-white photograph of a modernist building complex, featuring a prominent structure with a distinctive geometric, textured façade and large glass windows. The architecture is characterized by mid-20th-century modernist design, with sharp angles, clean lines, and the use of concrete and glass. There are a few people walking up stairs in the foreground, and leafless trees suggest it is early spring or late autumn.
